nodes.name: Meta Verification (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta sends a GET request with hub.challenge when you click 'Verify and Save' in the Meta console. This branch answers it.

nodes.name: Token Matches?
nodes.notes: Verify token must equal what you type in the Meta console. Change BOTH places if you change it.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Inbound (POST)
nodes.notes: Meta POSTs every inbound message here. Default response mode replies 200 immediately, which satisfies Meta's 5-second rule.

nodes.name: CONFIG (Inbound)
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: all per-client settings live here. When cloning for a new client, change values here AND in 'CONFIG (Reminders)'.

nodes.name: Read Files Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the whole Files tab. Uses a Google SERVICE ACCOUNT credential (no OAuth redirect headaches on self-hosted n8n).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.from, type: 'text', text: { body: 'Hi! This number is not on our files list yet. Please contact your advisor to get started.' } }) }}

nodes.name: LLM Classify
nodes.notes: Goes through LiteLLM -> Ollama. The metadata block is forwarded to Langfuse automatically (success_callback in litellm config).

nodes.name: Route by Intent
nodes.notes: Fallback output handles GREETING and OTHER with one friendly status reply.
